picks.question: Will the rate of CPI inflation be above 3.5% for the year ending in September 2026?
picks.why: Inflation above 3.5% would limit the Fed's room to cut rates and keep pressure on household purchasing power and borrowing costs.

picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: About a fifth of global oil passes through Hormuz, so prolonged disruption shapes energy prices, inflation, and growth worldwide.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A one-time billionaire wealth tax in the largest state would test the revenue potential, capital flight, and legal limits of taxing wealth.

picks.question: Will OpenAI’s market cap be $1.5T or greater at market close on IPO day by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: A trillion-dollar-plus AI listing would show how public markets value frontier AI and how concentrated equity indexes may become.

picks.question: Will Google have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Which lab leads frontier AI shapes competition, pricing power, and where AI-driven productivity gains are likely to accrue.

picks.question: Will OpenAI announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: AI cracking a famous unsolved math problem would signal research automation, with large implications for scientific productivity and innovation.
